{{Quote|I am TC-14 at your service.|[[TC-14/Legends|TC-14]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''TC-series protocol droid''', also known as the '''TC 3PO protocol droid''', was the first [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] line produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] to feature the [[TranLang III communications module/Legends|TranLang III communications module]].<ref name="SWI109" /> They were nearly identical to another Cybot product, the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]]. Most TC series protocol [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were made to serve aboard [[Space station/Legends|space stations]]. They were usually given a silver or red coat of paint. The TC series also somewhat lacked the eccentric behavior the 3PO units were known to develop. Due to his hodgepodge reconstruction, the famous protocol droid [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] had more mechanical similarities to the TC-series than to his own model.<ref name="Essential Guide">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
